### 1. Architecture Overview
- The OpenTelemetry Collector core defines `exporter.Settings` in `exporter/exporter.go` (repo: **opentelemetry-collector**, knowledgeId `f3537db5-0b7d-4942-8809-75ac43e2066f`). This struct is passed into every exporter factory when creating exporter instances.
- Exporter creation flows:
  - Factories are registered and invoked with `exporter.Settings` → see `exporter/exporter.go` (core factory interface) and builder logic in `service/internal/builders/exporter.go`.
  - Exporter builders (`CreateTraces`, `CreateMetrics`, `CreateLogs`, `CreateProfiles`) receive `exporter.Settings` and forward them to factories.
  - Example usage shows factories receiving `exporter.Settings` literals (e.g., `createExampleExporter` in `exporter/example_test.go`).
- Jaeger embeds/uses the Collector exporter factories and also passes `exporter.Settings` (repo: **jaeger**, knowledgeId `790f96e7-a83d-46f2-8868-4e80e0b32313`). Adding a required field will break all literal constructions across contrib and Jaeger.

### 2. Detailed Analysis
- **Core definition of Settings**  
  File: `exporter/exporter.go` (otel core)  
  `type Settings struct { ID component.ID; component.TelemetrySettings; BuildInfo component.BuildInfo; _ struct{} }` (~L33-45). This is the struct to which you must add `RetryConfig RetrySettings` (required). All factories and builders use it.
- **Factory contract**  
  Same file defines `Factory` interface and creation funcs: `CreateTraces`, `CreateMetrics`, `CreateLogs` accept `(ctx context.Context, set Settings, cfg component.Config)` (~L135-169). Any required field addition must be supplied at all call sites.
- **Factory option usage**  
  `exporter.NewFactory(...)` is used by exporters; see example below.
- **Builder usage**  
  File: `service/internal/builders/exporter.go` (otel core)  
  Methods `CreateTraces`, `CreateMetrics`, `CreateLogs`, `CreateProfiles` accept `set exporter.Settings` and pass it to factories (~L28-79). Any missing required field will panic/compile-fail.
- **Example literal construction**  
  File: `exporter/example_test.go` (otel core)  
  Function `createExampleExporter(ctx context.Context, params exporter.Settings, baseCfg component.Config)` (~L66-70) shows `exporter.Settings` passed by value; factories in contrib/Jaeger mirror this pattern. All such literals need the new required field.
- **Jaeger factory usage**  
  Jaeger factory files (e.g., `cmd/jaeger/internal/exporters/storageexporter/factory.go`, `components.go`) import `go.opentelemetry.io/collector/exporter` and receive `exporter.Settings` when creating exporters (per import search). They will need the new required field populated or constructor helpers adjusted.

### 3. Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| opentelemetry-collector | exporter/exporter.go | Defines `exporter.Settings` struct and Factory interfaces; add `RetryConfig RetrySettings` here (L33-45, L135-169). |
| opentelemetry-collector | service/internal/builders/exporter.go | Builder passes `exporter.Settings` into factories; any required field must be set in builder calls (CreateTraces/Metrics/Logs/Profiles). |
| opentelemetry-collector | exporter/example_test.go | Demonstrates factory construction and `exporter.Settings` parameter in `createExampleExporter`; literals here must include new field. |
| jaeger | cmd/jaeger/internal/exporters/storageexporter/factory.go | Jaeger exporter factory imports collector exporter package; receives `exporter.Settings` during creation and will fail if required field missing. |
| jaeger | cmd/jaeger/internal/components.go | Registers/constructs exporter factories and passes `exporter.Settings`; must populate new field. |

**What will break:** All callers constructing `exporter.Settings` literals across otel-core, otel-contrib exporters, and Jaeger must supply `RetryConfig RetrySettings`. Update helper constructors/builders (e.g., `service/internal/builders/exporter.go`) to set the new field (probably from config defaults) or provide a zero-value safe default if allowed.

SUMMARY: Adding a required RetryConfig RetrySettings field to the exporter.Settings struct will break all callers that construct Settings literals across otel-core, otel-contrib exporters, and Jaeger. The change requires updating the core definition and all factory creation sites, including builders and example tests, to supply the new field.

FILES:
- opentelemetry-collector/exporter/exporter.go — Defines the Settings struct and Factory interfaces; add the required field here
- opentelemetry-collector/service/internal/builders/exporter.go — Builder methods pass Settings to factories and must set the new field
- opentelemetry-collector/exporter/example_test.go — Example literals must include the new required field
- jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/exporters/storageexporter/factory.go — Jaeger factory receives Settings and will fail if the required field is missing
- jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/components.go — Registers exporter factories and passes Settings; must populate the new field
